title.zh: 原子氢质子弹性动量转移截面

summary: Compute the proton-on-stationary-hydrogen momentum-transfer cross section from laboratory energy. Clip the laboratory energy before converting to E_cm=E_lab/2; E_cm < 10 eV uses the low polynomial and E_cm >= 10 eV (laboratory energy >= 20 eV) uses the high polynomial, with the input shape preserved.

capability: H+-on-H momentum-transfer cross section in m^2 from laboratory energy in eV, with a 20 eV laboratory branch breakpoint.
operation: Evaluate the H+-on-H elastic momentum-transfer cross section
collision energies -> cross section per energy with the input shape preserved
discovery.model: Empirical H+-on-H momentum-transfer fit. The input laboratory energy is clipped, then divided by two; the polynomial variable is center-of-mass energy, with a 10 eV center-of-mass (20 eV laboratory) breakpoint.
discovery.geometry: None; scalar material function of collision energy with no spatial axis (coordinate: collision energy in eV; output in m^2).
discovery.boundary: Finite nonnegative laboratory input, clipped to [0.001, 1.01e5] eV before E_cm=E_lab/2; exactly 20 eV laboratory uses the high branch; the output preserves the input shape.

identity.relation: H+-on-H momentum-transfer cross section versus laboratory energy, with a 20 eV laboratory (10 eV center-of-mass) breakpoint
identity.direction: collision energies -> cross section per energy, with the input shape preserved
identity.definition: Clip the laboratory proton energy E_lab to [0.001, 1.01e5] eV, then set E_cm=E_lab/2. E_cm < 10 eV uses the seven-coefficient low-energy log polynomial and E_cm >= 10 eV uses the two-coefficient high-energy polynomial. The cross section is exp(poly(log(E_cm)))*1e-4 m^2. Exactly 20 eV laboratory belongs to the high branch; the segments are not forced continuous and the output preserves the input shape.
identity.model: Empirical H+-on-H momentum-transfer fit. The input laboratory energy is clipped, then divided by two; the polynomial variable is center-of-mass energy, with a 10 eV center-of-mass (20 eV laboratory) breakpoint.
identity.geometry: none; a scalar material function of collision energy
identity.coordinates: collision energy in eV; output cross section in m^2
identity.boundary: Finite nonnegative laboratory input, clipped to [0.001, 1.01e5] eV before E_cm=E_lab/2; exactly 20 eV laboratory uses the high branch; the output preserves the input shape.
assumptions: The fixed low/high fit coefficients are evaluated at E_cm=E_lab/2 after laboratory-energy clipping. E_lab < 20 eV uses the low branch; E_lab >= 20 eV, including exactly 20 eV, uses the high branch.
endpoint clipping does not imply experimental accuracy outside the domain; the low and high segments may have a finite jump, and no unsupported smoothing is applied.
the output preserves the input shape without adding a leading singleton axis; negative energies, booleans, complex numbers and strings are rejected.

inputs.name: energy_ev
inputs.description: laboratory energy of the projectile proton in the stationary-hydrogen-target frame
inputs.constraints: finite and nonnegative; values outside the range take the fit endpoints

outputs.name: cross_section_m2
outputs.description: H+-H elastic momentum-transfer cross section with the input shape.
outputs.constraints: finite and positive; the output shape equals the input shape

preconditions: use the declared laboratory projectile energy and endpoint clipping convention
supported: scalar or array H+-H momentum-transfer cross sections, including the 20 eV laboratory (10 eV center-of-mass) breakpoint
excluded: experimental extrapolation outside the domain, a full collision frequency or a Maxwellian average; this function returns only the cross section

Directly adding the H-P momentum moment from SciRel's atomic matrix assembly to the momentum moment of a full-velocity charge-exchange gain-loss operator built from SIG_CX is unsupported. Separate channel outputs do not qualify that combined transport model.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: raises ValueError for non-real, non-finite or negative energies
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: evaluation on a valid clipped interval returns a finite positive number

example.description: Check the 20 eV laboratory (10 eV center-of-mass) breakpoint and finite positive cross sections on both sides.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.collisions import evaluate_hydrogen_proton_elastic_cross_section
y = evaluate_hydrogen_proton_elastic_cross_section(np.array([np.nextafter(20., 0.), 20., np.nextafter(20., np.inf)]))
assert y.shape == (3,)
assert np.isfinite(y).all() and (y > 0).all()
# breakpoint: CM 10 eV == 20 eV laboratory; 20 eV lab is the high branch.
high = np.exp(np.polynomial.polynomial.polyval(np.log(10.0), np.array([-3.231141e1, -1.386002e-1]))) * 1.0e-4
np.testing.assert_allclose(y[1], high, rtol=1e-15)
example.expected: Three finite positive cross sections with input shape; exactly 20 eV laboratory (10 eV center-of-mass) belongs to the high-energy branch, and the empirical fit may jump across the breakpoint.

scope: The 20 eV laboratory (10 eV center-of-mass) breakpoint is probed directly: E_lab<20 uses the low branch and E_lab>=20 uses the high branch, with immediate below/above inputs covered.
input-shape output, input rejection and endpoint-clipping assertions are retained
downstream atomic collision-matrix assembly and independent angular integration use the corrected piecewise definition

The declared equal-mass discrete momentum construction is checked through matrix assembly, Alpha contraction and moment reduction, including an explicitly constructed full-velocity CX gain-loss operator. This is algebraic and quadrature evidence, not a production combined transport solver or an independent cross-section accuracy oracle.
verification.evidence_ceiling: the declared piecewise fit and breakpoint behavior are established; no new universal experimental cross-section accuracy is established. Intake acceptance, human scientific approval and licensing are recorded separately
known_limitations: endpoint clipping and the discontinuity between the low- and high-energy segments are inherited; no unsupported smoothing is applied
a previous qualification withdrawal and pending licensing remain recorded; this correction does not rewrite that history

the momentum-transfer cross section of this fit contains the momentum carried by resonant charge exchange (APID 8, 1999, section 1.2, p. 2-3); it is not a distinguishable-particle momentum-transfer cross section, and no distinguishable-particle parameterization exists in this repository

The resonant charge-exchange share of the total momentum transfer remains unquantified (UNKNOWN). Independent validation of separated channels over the underlying 0.1-100 eV center-of-mass table range has not been established here; this is a verification gap, not a claim that suitable literature or data do not exist.
